description: This file defines the LeftPosition struct which represents the left position attribute in shape objects within the MigraDoc document object model. It includes constructors, property getters/setters, and methods for serialization and type conversion related to shape positioning.

classes.name: LeftPosition
classes.description: Represents the left position in a shape, encapsulating position via units or enum shape positions, with various constructors and serialization support.

methods.name: LeftPosition
methods.description: Constructor initializing LeftPosition from a Unit value.

methods.name: LeftPosition
methods.description: Constructor initializing LeftPosition from a ShapePosition enum value.

methods.name: SetFromEnum
methods.description: Sets the shape position enum and resets the position to default.

methods.name: SetFromUnit
methods.description: Sets the position from a Unit value and resets shape position to undefined.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value of LeftPosition from an object, supporting enum or string.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Gets the current value of the position, either as a unit or enum.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Resets the object to a null state.
